DPointCircleEmit
create emitType emt enum 0
emitType field Radial 0
emitType field Fill 1
emitType keyable 1
emitType storable 1
add emitType
create radius rad float 5
radius min 0
add radius
create sampling sa int 10
sampling min 0
sampling max 10000000
add sampling
create startAngle san float 0
add startAngle
create endAngle ean float 360
add endAngle
create offsetAngle oan float 0
add offsetAngle
create Seed se int 0
Seed min 0
add Seed
create outDP odp geometry null
outDP writable 0
outDP storable 0
add outDP
affects emitType outDP
affects radius outDP
affects sampling outDP
affects startAngle outDP
affects endAngle outDP
affects offsetAngle outDP
affects Seed outDP
DPointSurfaceEmit

inSurfaceObject storable 0
add inSurfaceObject

samplingType field All 0
samplingType field Range 1
samplingType field CVs 2
samplingType keyable 1
samplingType storable 1
add samplingType
create samplingU sau int 10
samplingU min 0
samplingU max 10000000
add samplingU
create samplingV sav int 10
samplingV min 0
samplingV max 10000000
add samplingV
create uLength ul float 1
add uLength
create vLength vl float 1
add vLength
create uOffset uof float 0
add uOffset
create vOffset vof float 0
add vOffset
create outDP odp geometry null
outDP writable 0
outDP storable 0
add outDP
affects inSurfaceObject outDP
affects samplingType outDP
affects samplingU outDP
affects samplingV outDP
affects uLength outDP
affects vLength outDP
affects uOffset outDP
affects vOffset outDP
